h_phi_audit.lookup_model: stateless 64-byte cache-conscious B-Tree over sorted 16-byte records; payload is raw UTF-8 slice

hash_algorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over filename stem, ASCII A-Z folded to lowercase
lookup_layout: 64-byte cache-conscious B-Tree between record table and payload; leaf values are record indices
record_layout: uint32 hash, uint32 raw_offset, uint32 raw_length, uint32 pad

rtx_overkill.lookup: same B-Tree topology with higher prefetch stride and richer presentation outside lookup truth

toaster.lookup: B-Tree traversal with prefetch weight near zero; stream one raw UTF-8 slice
